name: 1N277
description: Gold-bonded (metallurgically bonded) germanium diode: higher current handling and lower noise than a point-contact germanium, with the same low ~0.3V forward drop. 110V reverse rating. Used for detection, low-level rectification, and germanium clipping. Banded end is the cathode.

DO-7.notes: small glass axial body; the band marks the cathode.

typical_application: Detector and low-level rectification, germanium clipping in pedals; the gold-bonded build takes more current and runs quieter than point-contact germanium.
gotchas: gold-bonded beats point-contact (more current, less noise) but it is still germanium: leakage, temperature drift, and NOS part-to-part spread
not a power rectifier despite the 500mA peak - 80mW average dissipation limit
verified against a second-source (BKC) sheet; original JEDEC 1N277 made by various, NOS parts vary
